checkPermissionLegacy -> checkPermissionScoped or  checkPermissionWithMapping
checkPermissionDualCheck -> checkPermissionStackRoleAndFolder or checkPermissionWithFolderAuthz

From @gamab :

2 things:

Some of the actions won't have the Name field set and be caught on the capabilities check above (list/watch/deletecollection). I am not sure the logic is correct here.
Do we need to support VerbGetPermissions / VerbSetPermissions ? -> requiring admin
Not sure we need to FT ?

WIP From @gamab :
Can name be empty, but folder set, if we want to test capabilities for a specific folder?
So in this case(we also need to check that folder is empty), else let it flow-through

Comment: This will also mean that subresource will also inherit folders permissions the same way.
ex: workflow.grafana.app/workflows/execute:create ->  "folders:write", "folders:edit", "folders:admin"
Let's add tests to check resource and subresource, no name, no folder, etc...
